### Summary

* Reviewed the KRA-1368 implementation already present at PR head `7e28bb5`. Stable GitHub review/comment identities are carried separately from the fetch-local ordering field, with missing identities handled fail-closed. [.github/scripts/review_loop.pyL1888-L1915](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/.github/scripts/review_loop.py#L1888-L1915)
* Confirmed `result_state_unchanged` compares identity, timestamp, and verdict kind, while treating two no-verdict states as unchanged; `verdict_state_held` performs the publication-time GitHub re-read. [.github/scripts/review_loop.pyL5382-L5405](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/.github/scripts/review_loop.py#L5382-L5405) [.github/scripts/review_loop.pyL5421-L5450](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/.github/scripts/review_loop.py#L5421-L5450)
* Confirmed the guard precedes the liveness check on wake redelivery, exhaustion, Codex nudge, and substitute summon publication paths. [.github/scripts/review_loop.pyL5713-L5732](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/.github/scripts/review_loop.py#L5713-L5732) [.github/scripts/review_loop.pyL6194-L6213](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/.github/scripts/review_loop.py#L6194-L6213) [.github/scripts/review_loop.pyL6284-L6307](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/.github/scripts/review_loop.py#L6284-L6307) [.github/scripts/review_loop.pyL6320-L6332](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/.github/scripts/review_loop.py#L6320-L6332)
* Confirmed regression coverage includes same-second same-kind redelivery replacement, result-stream consistency, and concurrent verdicts landing before nudge, substitute summon, and exhaustion publication. [tests/test_review_loop.pyL6556-L6584](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/tests/test_review_loop.py#L6556-L6584) [tests/test_review_loop.pyL6761-L6793](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/tests/test_review_loop.py#L6761-L6793) [tests/test_review_loop.pyL6796-L6829](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/tests/test_review_loop.py#L6796-L6829) [tests/test_review_loop.pyL6832-L6855](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/tests/test_review_loop.py#L6832-L6855) [tests/test_review_loop.pyL6858-L6885](https://github.com/RationallyPrime/weave-doctrine/blob/7e28bb5b324491ef4da24f544ce5360ec352e143/tests/test_review_loop.py#L6858-L6885)
* No additional code changes were necessary, so no follow-up commit or pull request was created.

**Testing**

* ✅ `uv run --with pytest,typer,pyyaml,pyarrow,httpx pytest tests/test_review_loop.py -q` — 428 tests passed.
* ⚠️ `just test tests/test_review_loop.py` — could not run because `just` is not installed in this environment; the equivalent focused pytest suite above passed.
* ✅ `git status --short` — working tree remained clean.
